title: Karnaugh maps and simplification
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: Choose the model answer: Simplify ¬(A ∨ B).
Choose the model answer: Keys 7 and 12 hash to index 2 in a table. What is that called?
Choose the model answer: What is 1 XOR 1?
Choose the model answer: If A changes from 0 to 1 while B is always 1, which variable is constant?

blocks.title: Read the labels
blocks.text: Rows represent A, and columns use Gray order BC: 00, 01, 11, 10.

blocks.title: Group neighbouring ones
blocks.text: The four 1s form one 2×2 rectangle. Adjacency across rows is allowed.

blocks.title: Keep what is constant
blocks.text: A and C change through the group, but B remains 0. So the simplified result is ¬B.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict and explain
blocks.text: B and C each vary across the row; neither is needed in the expression.

blocks.title: Worked example · Check and extend
blocks.text: A stays 0 in the whole group. The simplified term is ¬A.
